description:

The Council have appointed a provider via a call off from the Procurement for Housing Retrofit and Decarbonisation Dynamic Purchasing System (Lot 5)

A solar PV system will be installed to help offset electricity costs, enabling the new heating system to be partially powered by the Solar PV System. In addition, insulation improvements will enhance heat retention, reducing the need for prolonged operation of the heating system and further lowering energy consumption.

The scope of works will include:

•	Gas boiler and gas heater removal
•	Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) installation
•	Solar PV installation 
•	Electric water heater installation

title: Contract for a 5G Smart Port Partner
description:
The NE7 represent the Northeast local authorities that are coming together to form a new Mayoral Combined Authority. The strengths/growth areas of this Authority are Agriculture, Manufacturing (with associated Transport and Logistics) and Creative Arts.

Together we have bid to the '5G Innovation Regions' competition being run by the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology to deliver a number of projects that will contribute to establishing Northeast England as a national centre of excellence for terrestrial and non-terrestrial 5G use-case development and adoption, accelerating the economic, social and wellbeing impact of advanced digital connectivity through rapid adoption and scale-up across key sectors - whilst boosting economic performance of the region.

South Tyneside Council, a NE7 member, are leading one of these projects which is to innovate in Smart Ports. This procurement is for a Smart Port partner, subject to approval of the bid.

This procurement is for a Smart Port Partner who will be required to explore 5G-enabled port operations to improve port competitiveness and safety and reduce environmental impact.

UK ports are actively investing in 5G networks to help to drive sustainable economic growth in the region and support the transition to Net Zero.

This project, which will allow for 5G cameras and IoT sensors to inspect the Port estate, boosting efficiency and reducing fuel usage, will enable ports to drive forward plans to become all-electric.

Once established, 5G infrastructure at ports will be used a testbed for innovation companies to pilot their technology within a port environment to accelerate products for the betterment of the UK maritime sector. We will also disseminate the learnings in real time to our Northeast Ports of Tyne, Blyth, and Sunderland - as well as to wider UK Ports and 5G Ecosystem.

Key deliverables will be

• Mobile AI port safety solution

• Emissions and Asset Monitoring solution

• AI Analytics solution

title: Monkton Terrace Footbridge Parapet Replacement and General Maintenance
description:
The Monkton Terrace Footbridges were constructed in circa 1974. They comprise two separate structures supporting public footpaths. Each bridge sits either side of the Network Rail bridge (masonry arch) which carries the main carriageway of Monkton Terrace.
The structures carry pedestrians and cyclists over two railway lines. The northern line is owned by Network Rail and carries goods traffic to and from the Shell Oil Refinery in Jarrow. The southern line is owned by Nexus Rail and forms part of the Pelaw to South Shields branch of the Tyne and Wear Metro.

Initial works
The following remedial works are proposed prior to commencing works on the East footbridge:
o	Erect pedestrian diversion signs
o	Prepare the site compound and secure the site 
o	Ensure that Nexus Metro rail possession and permits are in place
Main works
The following remedial works are proposed for both of the footbridges:
•	Install rail protection measures to the footbridge.
•	Removal of existing parapets and cutting down of the sockets to below the surface of the existing reinforced concrete plinth.
•	Treating and repair of the voids within the concrete plinth, created from the removal of the parapet. 
•	Extension of the existing concrete plinth (from 200mm to 300mm) to accommodate the new parapet connection details.
•	Installation of new surface mounted parapets, to both footbridges, which will be drilled and bolted down into the extended reinforced concrete upstand. 
•	The deck waterproofing system, joints and surfacing will also be replaced and repaired as part of these works.
•	Miscellaneous maintenance repairs.
•	The works are to be undertaken following the installation of edge protection, which will be undertaken during overnight possessions of the Nexus Rail lines. Further possessions will be required for:
o	the re-pointing of the existing abutments and the removal of the edge protection.

title: NTCA DPS for the supply and delivery of Business Support Interventions within North East Region
description:
The North of Tyne Combined Authority (NTCA) is seeking to establish a multi-supplier, multi-category Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the delivery of Local Business Support Services within the North East area. The primary focus of the DPS will be delivery of business support activities, including those identified in the UKSPF Investment Plans prepared by each of the five accountable bodies (as listed below) and approved by UK Government on the 5th of December 2022; interventions are expected to be bespoke to regional need and designed to reflect the unique mix of assets, sectors and opportunities in the area. The NTCA and other Purchasers listed cannot guarantee the level and spend to be procured via this DPS. The total value of the DPS is expected to be approximately £30m. This DPS will not be the only route to market used by the NTCA and other Purchases listed for delivery of business support services. They reserve the right to select alternative routes to market as required.  \r
